sourceFile: 026.MSU-20S15-07 Result check NTI test bonding Frame VP offset 0.13_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable Normal vs change bonding frame+VP offset evidence exists, but outcome parsing and cited support are not reliable enough for final use.
issues: Changed-condition row NG rate function!6 is cited but not shown in review context.
Function outcome may ignore Hearing +1V/+0V defect counts and rates.
SPL/IMP/THD measurement outcome uses header rows only and lacks actual data-row citations.
FO measurement subresults are misparsed from row labels, producing nonsensical stats.
Review title is a raw data row, not a case description.
requiredUserQuestions: Should Hearing +1V and +0V rates be treated as function NG outcomes?
Does NG rate function!6 define the change bonding line offset 0.13 condition?
correctionPlan: Add citeable rows for both normal and changed function lines, including row 6 text.
Recompute function results using the intended defect columns and rates.
Regroup SPL, THD, IMP, and FO as Test vs Normal measurements with actual data rows cited.
Remove misparsed FO label-index statistics and use Test AVG vs Normal AVG where supported.
Replace the review title with a concise Normal vs offset 0.13 bonding frame+VP title.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row existence is sufficient, but citations are not sufficient for final evidence because key condition and measurement data rows are missing or misparsed.
